title: Alert for Palm Hill Residents
summary: Two young adults were seen looking into lanais and between homes near Royal Palm and Sago Palm. Lock vehicles, remove keys, and report suspicious activity to Largo Police.
public_detail: Just alerting our Palm Hill neighbors - 2 young adults were on what looked like electric skateboards early this morning - they appeared to have hats with lights on, and they were looking into lanai's and between houses. These photos are on Royal Palm across from overflow parking and the intersection of Sago Palm. Please make sure that your vehicles are locked and keys are removed.
